40 YR old male ,farmer by occupation"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003EThis is an online E log consent.\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHere we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patient's clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis E log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.”\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI've been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003ECASE\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 40 year old male ,resident of Nalgonda ,came to the OPD with\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/O fever since 15 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/O head ache since 15 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/O pain abdomen since 10 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/O blood in stools since morning\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cb\u003EDaily routine :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E40 yr old male,married for 25 years with 2 kids one daughter and one son lives along with his father and brother. Lives in pacca house with 4 rooms surrounded by compound wall no crack in the walls\u0026nbsp; ( with no pets , has rats and mosquitoes,no cockraches or insects with no stagnant water bodies nearby or drainage )\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShares good relations with all his family members (according to him and his wife ) calm going and not aggressive by nature .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe wakes up at 5 am in the morning and finishes his daily needs and goes to work in the farm by 7 in the morning.His work involves producing millets,feeding cows (has about 4 cows which are near his farm ),exposure to pesticides.On questioning he even mentions about small insects in farms (?ticks).Has his lunch in the farm itself (carries lunch box - mostly rice ) returns home in the evening ,drinks toddy ,eats his dinner and sleeps by 9 - 10 pm .sometimes he even sleeps in the farm.The day before developing of fever he worked more than usual and had history od spraying pesticides.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGives no history of any insect bite or any travel history\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of present illness :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPt was apparently asymptomatic 1 year back.later he passed blood in stools for 2 days\u0026nbsp; which was insidious in onset along with painful defecation\u0026nbsp; for which he visited hospital and treated conservatively (given syrup ) and his symptoms got subsided\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;Around 15 days back he developed high grade,continuous type of fever which is insidious in onset ,gradually progressive with diurnal variation,more during nights subsided on taking medication\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/O pain abdomen more in the left iliac fossa ,non radiating and not associated with nausea\/vomitings\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/O headache (more in the frontal region) non radiating ,not associated with diminished or blurring of vision\u0026nbsp; or photophobia\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/O loss of appetite since 1 week\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/O blood in stools since morning -fresh blood ,mixed with stools(hard stools)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo complaints of cough,cold,vomitings or nausea or diarrhoea ,burning micturition\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPast history\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E :\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo similar complaints in the past\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot a k\/c\/o of diabetes,hypertension,asthma,epilepsy,thyroid,CVA\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of any surgeries or blood transfusions in the past\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPersonal history :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet - Veg\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite - decreased\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESleep - adequate\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel and bladder movements - regular\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo known allergies\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of toddy consumption daily\u0026nbsp; since he was 10 years old\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of tobbaco consumption - 10 years back for 10 years (stopped randomly when he got fever 10 yrs back\u0026nbsp; and his fever and appetite got bad with smoking )\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EGeneral examination :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPt is conscious, coherent,cooperative\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo signs of pallor,icterus,cyanosis ,clubbing, lymphadenopathy,edema\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EModerately built and nourished\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E40 yr old male,married for 25 years with 2 kids one daughter and one son lives along with his father and brother. Lives in pacca house with 4 rooms surrounded by compound wall no crack in the walls ( with no pets , has rats and mosquitoes,no cockraches or insects with no stagnant water bodies nearby or drainage )\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003EShares good relations with all his family members (according to him and his wife ) calm going and not aggressive by nature .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003EHe wakes up at 5 am in the morning and finishes his daily needs and goes to work in the farm by 7 in the morning.His work involves producing millets,feeding cows (has about 4 cows which are near his farm ),exposure to pesticides.On questioning he even mentions about small insects in farms (?ticks).Has his lunch in the farm itself (carries lunch box - mostly rice ) returns home in the evening ,drinks toddy ,eats his dinner and sleeps by 9 - 10 pm.The day before developing of fever,he worked more than usual and has history of sleeping in the farm 2 days ago and spraying of pesticides\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003EGives no history of any insect bite or any travel history\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003EHistory of present illness :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003EPt was apparently asymptomatic 1 year back.later he passed blood in stools for 2 days which was insidious in onset along with painful defecation for which he visited hospital and treated conservatively (given syrup ) and his symptoms got subsided\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
